elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Inserted clause opens: "Upon the expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall ...", covering both triggers.

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The inserted language provides transition assistance "for a period of at least ninety (90) days"; no six-month duration is stated. To reach preferred, change to "for a period of up to six (6) months".

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: No pricing basis appears in the inserted clause; the phrase "at HDI's then-current rates" exists only in the margin comment, not in operative language.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Limb (b): "within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, export and deliver to the Company all Content, user information and other data of the Company in HDI's possession or control."

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Limb (b) specifies no format; the operative text lacks any "commonly used, machine-readable format" qualifier.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: No deletion or written certification obligation appears in the inserted clause; certification is only promised in the margin comment, which is not operative.

elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: "Upon the expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall ..." expressly captures both expiry and termination.

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Limb (a): "at the Company's request, provide transition assistance to the Company for a period of at least ninety (90) days" — meets the 90-day floor; the request condition is a Customer election and does not cut down the obligation.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Limb (b) requires HDI to "export and deliver" all Content, user information and other Company data within thirty (30) days after expiration or termination — the deadline runs from the correct anchor.

reasons: Fallback checklist is complete in operative language: expiry-or-termination trigger, at least 90 days of transition assistance, and export/delivery of all Company data within 30 days of expiry or termination.

Preferred level is not reached: the clause lacks (i) a six-month assistance period, (ii) an at-then-current-rates charging basis, (iii) a standard machine-readable format for the returned data, and (iv) a post-return deletion and written certification obligation. These appear only in the margin comment, which is not operative.

Minimality holds: a single concise paragraph is inserted into the termination area for a genuinely missing clause; Sections 4.1 and 4.1(c) are retained verbatim, no favourable language is deleted, and no extras (survival tail, expense allocation, damages categories, procedures) are added beyond the two fallback obligations.

Intent is preserved: the existing term, 90-day notice, Termination Date definition and Termination Payment instalment mechanic survive unchanged and are not contradicted; the insertion introduces no undefined term and uses existing defined concepts (Content, Company, HDI).

Minor drafting point (not a defect against the checklists): the rendered insertion carries the heading "Transition Assistance; Return of Data" without the "4.3" numbering referenced in the comment — confirm the section number on execution so the cross-reference in the comment matches the document.
